🌌🍫 Galactic Chocolate Mirror Cake 🍫🌌 Ingredients: For the chocolate cake: 2 cups (250 g) all-purpose flour 2 cups (400 g) granulated sugar ¾ cup (75 g) unsweetened cocoa powder 2 teaspoons baking powder 1½ teaspoons baking soda 1 teaspoon salt 1 cup (240 ml) buttermilk, room temperature ½ cup (120 ml) vegetable oil 2 large eggs, room temperature 2 teaspoons vanilla extract 1 cup (240 ml) hot coffee (or hot water) For the chocolate ganache filling: 1½ cups (270 g) semi-sweet chocolate chips 1 cup (240 ml) heavy cream 2 tablespoons butter For the galaxy mirror glaze: 1 tablespoon gelatin powder ¼ cup (60 ml) cold water 1 cup (200 g) granulated sugar ⅔ cup (160 ml) sweetened condensed milk ½ cup (120 ml) water 1½ cups (270 g) white chocolate, chopped Gel food coloring (blue, purple, black, and pink) Edible glitter or luster dust (optional for stars ✨) Directions: Make the cake layers: Preheat oven to 350°F (175°C). Grease and line three 8-inch round pans with parchment paper. In a large mixing bowl, whisk together flour, sugar, cocoa, baking powder, baking soda, and salt. Add buttermilk, oil, eggs, and vanilla. Mix until smooth. Gradually stir in hot coffee (batter will be thin). Divide evenly into pans and bake for 25–30 minutes, or until a toothpick comes out clean. Cool completely before assembling. Prepare the ganache filling: Heat heavy cream in a saucepan until just simmering. Pour over chocolate chips and butter in a bowl. Let sit for 3 minutes, then whisk until smooth and glossy. Allow to cool slightly before using. Assemble the cake: Place one cake layer on a serving plate. Spread a layer of ganache. Repeat with the second and third layers. Smooth the outside with ganache for a clean surface. Refrigerate for 1 hour to set. Prepare the galaxy mirror glaze: Sprinkle gelatin over ¼ cup cold water and let bloom for 10 minutes. In a saucepan, combine sugar, sweetened condensed milk, and ½ cup water. Bring to a gentle boil, then remove from heat. Add bloomed gelatin and stir until fully dissolved. Pour over chopped white chocolate and let sit for 5 minutes. Blend with an immersion blender until smooth (avoid bubbles). Divide the glaze into separate bowls and tint with food colors (blue, purple, black, and pink). Let the glaze cool to about 90°F (32°C). Create the galaxy effect: Pour the colored glazes into one large bowl in swirls (don’t mix). Pour the glaze over the chilled cake from the center outward, letting the colors blend naturally. Add edible glitter or luster dust for a starry galaxy look. Finish and serve: Let the glaze drip and set for 10–15 minutes. Slice and serve your stunning Galactic Chocolate Mirror Cake! Nutritional Information (per slice): ⏰ Prep Time: 1 hour | Baking Time: 30 minutes | Chill Time: 2 hours | Total Time: ~3½ hours 🔥 Kcal: ~520 kcal per slice 🍽️ Servings: 12 This Galactic Chocolate Mirror Cake is as mesmerizing as it is delicious — rich chocolate layers filled with creamy ganache and topped with a cosmic swirl of glossy glaze. Perfect for birthdays, celebrations, or anyone who loves desserts that are out of this world! 🌠 #GalaxyCake #MirrorGlaze #ChocolateDessert #CosmicBaking #ShowstopperCake

Chocolate Brownie Lava Cake 🍫🌋 Ingredients: - For Chocolate Sponge - • 240g plain flour • 30g cocoa powder • 400g granulated sugar • 2tsp bicarbonate of soda • 1tsp baking powder • 240ml milk • 110g vegetable oil • 2 large eggs • 1tsp vanilla extract • 50g milk chocolate • 150ml hot water - For Chocolate Icing - • 250g unsalted butter • 500g icing sugar • 50g cocoa powder • 1tsp vanilla extract • 3tbsp milk - For Brownie Lava - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 70g unsalted butter • 40g cocoa powder • 40g plain flour (heat treated) • 80g double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 70g milk chocolate - For Brownie Bites - • 100g light brown sugar • 50g granulated sugar • 90g unsalted butter • 60g cocoa powder • 120g plain flour (heat treated) • 2-3tbsp double cream • 1tsp vanilla extract • a pinch of salt • 100g chocolate chips Instructions: - For Chocolate Sponge - 1) In a large bowl, combine your flour, cocoa powder, granulated sugar, bicarbonate of soda, and baking powder 2) In another bowl, whisk together your milk, vegetable oil, eggs, vanilla extract, and 50g melted milk chocolate 3) Fold in your dry ingredients from before and add in 150ml hot water or coffee 4) Line three 8” cake tins and pour in the batter evenly. Bake in the oven at 160°C fan for around 25 minutes - For Icing - 1) Whisk your butter until light and creamy 2) Add in your icing sugar and cocoa powder 3) Once incorporated, whisk in your vanilla and milk until fluffy  - For Brownie Lava - 1) Melt the butter with both sugars over a medium heat 2) Whisk in the cocoa powder and flour 3) Gradually add in the cream until molten and thick, then stir in the vanilla extract and salt 4) Let it cool to just above room temperature and then add in the milk chocolate to slowly melt in 5) Once the lava has reached room temperature, you can use it on your cake! - For Bronwie Bites - 1) Cream together the butter and both sugars until fluffy 2) Mix in the cocoa powder, flour, and salt until sandy 3) Add in the vanilla extract and double cream 4) Once it has become a dough, fold in your chocolate chips, then press it firmly into a lined 9x9” square tin, refrigerate for 30 minutes, then cut into small bite sized pieces  Watch the video to see how I build and decorate the cake! Añade el chocolate y mezcla con una espátula hasta que se integre por completo 🔹️ Añade la harina tamizada y mezcla con la espátula hasta que esté perfectamente integrado 🔹️ Pincela los moldes con mantequilla a punto de pomada y espolvorea con cacao en polvo 🔹️ Llena los moldes con la masa hasta 1 cm del borde. 🍫 Chocolate Molten Lava Cake Ingredients * ½ cup semi-sweet chocolate chips * ⅓ cup butter * 2 eggs * 2 egg yolks * ¼ cup sugar * ¼ cup all-purpose flour * Butter, for greasing ramekins * Cocoa powder, for dusting * Powdered sugar, for garnish Instructions 1. Prepare the ramekins: Preheat your oven to 425°F. Generously butter the inside of the ramekins, then dust with cocoa powder, shaking out any excess. 2. Melt the chocolate: In a microwave-safe bowl, combine the chocolate chips and butter. Microwave in 30-second increments, stirring well after each, until completely melted and smooth. Set aside. 3. Mix the eggs: In a separate bowl, add the eggs, egg yolks, and sugar. Beat for about 2 minutes, until the mixture becomes lighter and slightly thickened. 4. Combine: Add the flour and melted chocolate mixture to the egg mixture. Mix until everything is completely combined and smooth. 5. Fill the ramekins: Divide the batter evenly between the prepared ramekins. 6. Bake: Place in the preheated oven and bake for 12–13 minutes. The edges should be set while the center remains soft. 7. Rest and remove: Let the cakes sit for 1–2 minutes after removing them from the oven. Carefully loosen the edges with a knife if needed, then invert onto a serving plate. 8. Serve: Dust with powdered sugar and serve immediately while the center is warm and gooey. 🍫✨#fyp #viral #fypシ #cake #chocolate

The epitome of chocolate heaven🍫🤩🍰 if you love chocolate, you need this crockpot chocolate lava cake in your life!🙌 Crockpot Chocolate Lava Cake Recipe: Ingredients:  Cake Batter: 1 cup all-purpose flour ¾ cup granulated sugar 3 tbsps cocoa powder 2 tsps baking powder  ¼ tsp salt ½ cup milk ⅓ cup butter ½ cup dark chocolate chips 2 tsps vanilla bean paste Cake Topping: ¾ cup granulated sugar ¾ cup light brown sugar ⅓ cup cocoa powder ½ cup dark chocolate chips 2 ¼ cup hot water Instructions: 1. Mix cake batter dry ingredients: In a large bowl, mix together the flour, granulated sugar, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt.  2. Mix cake batter wet ingredients: In a separate bowl, microwave your butter and dark chocolate chips in 30 second increments until fully melted.  3. Combine your wet & dry ingredients, & spread it on the bottom of your crockpot. 4. Cake Topping: Mix your granulated sugar, brown sugar, & cocoa powder together. Sprinkle this on top of your cake batter along with the chocolate chips. Pour your hot water overtop of everything, & don’t stir it in. 5. Cover, & cook on high for 2-2.5 hours.
